correctness.rationale: The Jacobi recurrence is normalized by reversible weights. Its even/odd block is the explicit invertible upper-bidiagonal A. Contractivity yields D=I-A*A≥0; its exact diagonal and trace-class entries give the stated rational trace. Trace-class triangular approximation gives det(A*A)=the complete Euler product. Nonzero off-diagonals and exclusion of ±1 square-summable formal solutions identify all positive paired nodes as δ_j=1-x_j². The bounded rescaling C=W^-1/2 D W^-1/2 has a simple zero eigenvector u_k=q^-k√h(2k), and essential spectrum separated from zero. Positivity on u-perp and rank-one interlacing yield c_q q^-2j≤δ_j≤M_q q^-2(j-1), hence sharp logarithmic counting. All finite checks are auxiliary; q≥5, all quantifiers and endpoints are explicit.

value.rationale: The 2026 geometric polynomial hypergroup comes with a purely discrete spectrum, but its spectral density near ±1 and global node invariants are not supplied by the motivating support theorem. The exact edge-counting coefficient measures the degree-frequency of points near the boundary, while the trace and Euler product quantify the total paired spectral deficit and determinant of the underlying contraction. These three compatible identities are motivated intrinsic invariants of the full natural spectrum, not arbitrary finite slices or a known table recomputation.
